visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal slider of authored product cards with prev/next arrows, 4 visible on desktop, 3 on tablet, 2 on mobile
visualCharacteristics.description: Horizontal product slider with prev/next arrows: product image on top, linked product name (single line, ellipsis), optional item number and price; 4 cards visible on desktop, 3 on tablet, 2 on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: one row per product; cell 1 = product image, cell 2 = product name linked to the product page, optional "Item Number: <sku>" paragraph, optional price paragraph

cells: Product name linked to the product page; optional "Item Number: <sku>" paragraph; optional price paragraph

usage: Bestseller Products and Featured Products rows on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for static, authored lists of products that link to product pages. For live catalog-driven lists use product-recommendations or product-list-page.
